newsitem.title: JAPAN: ANA to suspend new wage system for pilots - paper.
newsitem.headline: ANA to suspend new wage system for pilots - paper.

text.p: All Nippon Airways Co Ltd (ANA) will temporarily suspend a new wage system for its pilots due to opposition from its pilots' union, a Japanese business daily said over the weekend.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Sunday that the new system, introduced on April 1, 1996 to cut personnel costs, would be suspended for the fiscal year starting on April 1.
The pilots had refused to accept the wage system, saying it would worsen working conditions, the paper said.
The pilots have gone on strike twice since November and planned another strike later this year in protest, it said.
The paper said the ANA decision could affect the firm's overall restructuring plans.
It said ANA's cabin crew labour union had already accepted the new wage system.
The airline was not immediately available for comment.
